facts.text: Caroline shared a negative experience on a hike where she encountered a group of religious conservatives who made her upset.

evidence.quote: Recently, I had a not-so-great experience on a hike. I ran into a group of religious conservatives who said something that really upset me.

facts.text: Caroline expressed that having supportive people around her helps her feel okay despite negative experiences.

evidence.quote: It's been so helpful to have people around me who accept and support me, so I know I'll be ok!

facts.text: Melanie mentioned that she finished another pottery project and invited Caroline to see a photo of it.

evidence.quote: FYI, I finished another pottery project - want to see a pic?

facts.text: Melanie shared a photo of a colorful bowl, expressing pride in her pottery project.

evidence.quote: Here it is. Pretty proud of it! It was a great experience.
That bowl is awesome, Mel! What gave you the idea for all the colors and patterns?
